candidates.formal_type:
∀ (G : Type) [inst : Group.{0} G] [inst_1 : Fintype.{0} G] [inst_2 : DecidableEq.{1} G] (p : Nat),
  Nat.Prime p →
    ∀ (k : Nat),
      LT.lt.{0} 0 k →
        ∀ (g : G),
          Eq.{1} (Fintype.card.{0} (Subtype.{1} fun h => IsConj.{0} g h)) (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} p k) →
            Exists.{1} fun N => And (Subgroup.Normal.{0} N) (And (Ne.{1} N Bot.bot.{0}) (Ne.{1} N Top.top.{0}))

rule: Use primary exactly when the declaration itself states or defines the source claim. Use supporting for prerequisites, constructions, helper lemmas, instances, or consequences that help formalize the item but do not themselves state it.
source_text: A finite group with a conjugacy class of size p^k for prime p and k>0 has a proper nontrivial normal subgroup.
